stage: Read-only development review before new formal execution. New product/evaluation manifest generation and unified offline regression belong to the parent task.

resolved_findings.finding: Collector enumerated seven tasks but previously did not reject additional reserved repeat/reference/control rows while reporting zero reference/control runs.
resolved_findings.resolution: Collector now reads snapshot(BATCH), which validates the fixed anchor, policy and all immutable receipts, requires the exact set of seven formal-<task>-001 rows, and checks scope.references == 0 and scope.controls == 0.

resolved_findings.finding: Failure-time freeze verification could raise before stopped.json was saved.
resolved_findings.resolution: Driver now saves stopped.json with child return code before best-effort verification, catches verification RuntimeError and exits with child failure; subsequent tasks are not started. Other exceptional verification failures still leave the previously written stop record.

scope_and_execution.algorithm_review: No task-specific solving, scientific parser, generated Plan/input/code, reference calculation or result substitution is in the driver or collector. Driver initializes from frozen original text and invokes the existing product entrypoint. Knowledge audit reads existing Results/Artifacts and hashes existing body/excerpt bytes; it performs no HTTP retrieval.
scope_and_execution.only_run_path: verify -> prepare immutable slot -> untouched Run shell -> bind_run -> execute. prepare_workspace requires a fresh reserved slot and refuses reused workspace/Run/settlement; bind_run checks an untouched unique Run. Evidence directories use exclusive creation. No automatic retries, new IDs for a failed slot, or resume loop is added.
scope_and_execution.failure_policy: A product failed state can be recorded and the next authorized task attempted. Exceptions, unresolved/unknown execution, knowledge integrity issues or a slot overrun cause child failure and parent stop. Interrupted children leave reservations occupied; no refund or replacement is performed.
scope_and_execution.accounting: All five metrics are settled as known or explicitly unknown. Model token uncertainty is retained. Unresolved Attempt/internal execution causes ORCA/work metrics to remain unknown and preserves the full reservation. Actual ORCA and workload values come from Run usage; no output-derived cost guess. Wall time covers the product execute call, not acceptance verification/export overhead.

path_binding.driver_project: Path(__file__).parents[4] resolves to E:/BG6022-V4 for the current freeze location.
path_binding.driver_freeze: Event and product manifest are read from the new script parent freeze directory; all acceptance CLI invocations pass its --directory.
path_binding.collector_project: Path(__file__).parents[3] resolves to E:/BG6022-V4; explicit sys.path project insertion permits tests.helpers import in normal script execution.
path_binding.collector_batch: E:/BG6022-V4/data/code-tools-refreeze-1-batch is fixed and must equal the new freeze event batch_root.
path_binding.collector_destination: New refreeze-1 evidence directory; existing publication is refused.
path_binding.shared_environment: Driver derives LOCALAPPDATA from the saved existing environment root, verifies production default root equality in run_one, and retains the same global environment lease. It does not create a separate compute environment.

publication_checks: All seven slot/workspace/Run/prepare/settlement and pre/post verification records are checked before destination publication; each workspace must contain exactly its bound Run and current state/usage must match outcome.
Fixed roots are checked for symlink/reparse paths before file reads. All input files are streamed through SHA256 and known-key plus high-confidence credential scans; missing known key refuses export.

Payloads are limited to 512 KiB each and total publication including index/checksum to 20 MiB; larger originals remain locally hash-indexed. Required report.txt and other small driver receipts must fit or export stops.

Published payloads are indexed, source identity is rechecked before staging, staged hashes/size are verified, and exclusive destination rename publishes only a complete package. The collector starts no model, ORCA, container or task code.

validation.git_diff_check: passed with only existing CRLF conversion warnings

prepared_checks: Capture approved Request/Plan, automatic-selection reasons, knowledge provenance and proposed ORCA input/geometry before first science if observable.

Record method, basis, charge, multiplicity, electronic state, gas environment, geometry origin/hash, RI/dispersion/grid/SCF, optimization/frequency type, mass/scaling/projection settings and timestamps.
Only actual prelaunch captures are preregistration; absent selections remain unverified, and postlaunch captures are explicitly labeled.

Final audit requires ethanol C2H6O/9 atoms, optimization convergence and consistent frequency geometry, all 27 indexed modes including zero/negative/translation/rotation terms, and separate minimum/goal/operation/scientific status. Independent reference is outside this authorized single round and remains unverified.

limitations: Static review and syntax/import-resolution checks do not establish real runtime execution or isolation success.
The actual new freeze event/manifest, full unified offline tests and execution evidence are not inferred from this review.
The batch ledger protects this managed path; it does not detect arbitrary administrator computations outside the batch.
Credential scanning has bounded high-confidence patterns and one known provider key; it is not a claim to detect every possible secret.
Files can still change during development; the final freeze must bind their final bytes.
